runs.name: control
runs.methodology: Separate fresh worker process per workload and candidate, alternating AB/BA pairs, per-workload warmup, warm OS page cache. Import/setup/independent assertions excluded from per-operation latency. Every warmup and measured result checked. Speedup: geometric mean of paired round-mean ratios; seeded 10000-resample paired bootstrap 95% CI. Not end-to-end agent latency or cold-disk throughput.
